environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on EKS Fargate with Istio service mesh. Authentication tokens are issued by a custom STS endpoint backed by HashiCorp Vault Transit secrets engine with auto-rotation policy set to 60-second TTL on ephemeral signing keys. Each API bearer token is a Vault-wrapped response token with max_ttl=60s and use_limit=1 (single-use). The Vault lease on the signing key is non-renewable. Token validation occurs via a sidecar envoy filter that calls Vault's /sys/wrapping/lookup before proxying to the application container. A stolen token from a prior request is already consumed (use_limit=1) and the signing key has rotated, making replay impossible. The application container runs with a read-only filesystem and drops all capabilities. Istio AuthorizationPolicy restricts the /api/v1/reports/render endpoint to principals with a specific SPIFFE identity that requires fresh mTLS certificate rotation every 30 seconds via cert-manager CSI driver.

config.deployment: AWS EKS Fargate, Istio 1.20 service mesh
config.auth_token_backend: HashiCorp Vault Transit engine, key auto-rotation 60s TTL
config.mtls: Istio mTLS STRICT mode, SPIFFE identity required, cert-manager rotation 30s
config.network_policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy denies all egress except Vault and internal services on port 443
config.istio_authz: AuthorizationPolicy requires valid SPIFFE URI and fresh wrapped token
